limitation: Reference-only analytic/sample checks; not actuator feasibility or closed-loop validation.

reference.derivative_meaning: Euler heading and its time derivatives, not physical world-z angular velocity.
reference.endpoint_policy: Known geometric tangent at the initial stop; final geometric tangent held after motion, zero heading rate/acceleration.

path.endpoint_policy: Exactly zero velocity and acceleration before and after motion.
path.origin_policy: Fixed original world origin, no measured-state reanchor or reset.

reference.reference_inputs: Frozen planned path and time only; no measured state, contact, terrain or outcome.
